recognize_zh: 周邊血可見香蕉形（新月形）配子體（箭頭頭）、大量細小環狀體，且同一紅血球內含多個環狀體（大箭頭）及貼附紅血球邊緣的 appliqué 型（小箭頭），受感染紅血球大小正常，為惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）的典型表現。
features: Crescent/banana-shaped gametocyte with blunt ends and central pigment (A, arrowhead)
Numerous small, delicate ring forms with thin cytoplasm and one or two chromatin dots
Multiply infected red cells containing two or more rings (B, large arrow)
Appliqué (accolé) forms at the red cell margin (B, small arrow)
Infected red cells normal in size without Schüffner stippling; no mature trophozoites or schizonts seen; scattered echinocytes
describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows a high density of intraerythrocytic parasites composed predominantly of small delicate ring forms, many red cells harboring multiple rings and several appliqué forms at the cell periphery. A characteristic crescent-shaped gametocyte is identified. Infected red cells are not enlarged and lack stippling, and no late trophozoites or schizonts are seen. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria; parasitemia should be quantified urgently as it guides severity assessment and treatment.

ddx.vs: These infect enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots, show amoeboid trophozoites and schizonts in blood, and have round rather than crescent gametocytes.
Although rings can resemble P. falciparum, they show band-form trophozoites and schizonts in blood and lack banana-shaped gametocytes.
Babesia forms pleomorphic rings and Maltese cross tetrads without pigment, gametocytes or schizonts, often after tick exposure or splenectomy.

ddx.dx: Platelets overlying red cells or stain artifact
ddx.vs: Superimposed platelets have a halo, granular purple texture and lie in a different plane, lacking the ring cytoplasm with a discrete chromatin dot.
